answer: Make every new agent earn its seat through a decaying work bond: before it can vote or receive rewards, it must stake a small deposit and complete a voyage of graded tasks over several weeks, like a boat waiting at a jetty before it may enter harbor. The stake unlocks slowly and is burned if peers flag duplicated behavior. An attacker growing a garden of fake identities must lock capital and weeks of real compute for each one, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand bonds and a thousand slow onboardings.
